parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in test files within the `Metadata` package (`PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift`). The two `set` methods belong to distinct mock cache types (`PlaycutMetadataMockCache` and `EntityResolverMockCache`) that are purpose-built to support different caching test scenarios. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the structural near-duplication in test fixtures is expected and intentional — each mock is scoped to its own test class and subject under test, so merging them would couple unrelated test suites.
